messages:
rachel: Heads-up: after the RBAC tidy the scanner started failing KMS decrypts in CI. Blocking a couple merges.
sec-bot: alert: scan-worker fail_rate=0.2 recent_error="KMS:AccessDenied" link: https://ci.internal/runs/21001
omar: Likely the role-assume change. Key policy probably still lists the old SA principal.
june: Can you paste the log line?
rachel: log snippet: `2024-10-02T07:11:10Z scan ERROR decrypt error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::777777777:assumed-role/scan-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777:key/ab12-cd34`
omar: Quick plan: 1) soft-fail waiver so merges aren't blocked (infra-oncall) 2) patch key policy in staging adding assumed-role ARN 3) smoke decrypt 4) re-run failing subset 5) add preflight check to infra PR template.
infra-oncall: Waiver created WAIV-20241002-01 (60m).
june: I'll apply staging patch and run `aws kms decrypt` smoke.
sec-bot: incident created: "scan-kms-policy-mismatch" id=INC-20241002-01
rachel: After staging validation, roll to prod. Also file a short postmortem and add RBAC->KMS checklist to runbook.
omar: Long-term: infra CI should flag KMS key policies that reference principals removed by role/principal changes. I'll open a ticket.
june: Staging patch applied; decrypt smoke OK. Re-ran subset, unwraps fixed.
infra-oncall: Prod patch applied after staging validation. Waiver will expire unless issues recur.
rachel: Filing postmortem and adding preflight task. Thanks all for quick triage.
